name: bugfix-retry-swallowed
prompt: `fetchWithRetry` in `retry.js` is supposed to call `operation()` and retry up to `maxAttempts` times if it throws, only propagating the final error once attempts are exhausted. Right now `node retry.test.js` fails - it looks like a single failed attempt aborts the whole retry loop instead of retrying. Fix the bug in `retry.js` so `node retry.test.js` passes. Do not modify the test file.
